finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.trigger: arraySize is multiplied by sizeof(int) to calculate the total memory allocation. If arraySize is very large, this multiplication could overflow, leading to an allocation of less memory than intended.
finding.assumptions: The value of arraySize is not checked for overflow before being used to allocate memory. The sizeof(int) is assumed to be less than or equal to the size_t range.

parsed.refutation_attempt: arraySize is initialized to the constant value 10 on line 1, which is an internal compile‑time constant and not an untrusted source such as stdin, argv, or a public API parameter. Therefore, no attack can influence the value of arraySize, and the potential overflow cannot be triggered by an external input.
